definition: A product generated by the current rule engine for the same substrate but not the known positive product.
verification_gate: Screen decoy pair against current positive pool, Rhea, ECReact, EnzymeMap, and curated literature queue before using as hard negative.

definition: A paper reports a tested substrate/strain/enzyme condition where the product was not detected.
verification_gate: Must record assay, organism/strain, medium/time, detection method, limit, PMID/DOI, and tested product.

definition: A genome/model lacks the enzyme, gene, pathway, or reaction under a named organism context.
verification_gate: Requires genome completeness, annotation method, gene family, model source, and condition scope.

definition: The proposed pair is incompatible with the source reaction direction, stoichiometry, cofactor logic, or atom conservation.
verification_gate: Check atom balance, Rhea/EnzymeMap direction, cofactors, and current reaction rule direction.

definition: A pair is not found in Rhea/ECReact/EnzymeMap/current pool.
verification_gate: Absence is only a search result, never a biological negative.
